description: Runs a Kubernetes Job to completion and returns its logs and status, then deletes it.

namespace.description: Namespace to run the Job in.

image.description: Container image. With from_cronjob, replaces every container's image.

command.description: Command (with arguments) for a Job built from image.

from_cronjob.description: Create the Job from this CronJob's jobTemplate.

env.description: Environment variables added to every container.

service_account.description: ServiceAccount for a Job built from image.

name.description: Job name prefix. Default: the CronJob name, or bolt-job.

keep.description: Keep the Job afterwards instead of deleting it.
